per_update_cost_note: Training-side only, no extra simulation. PPO phase: +1 policy forward/backward per rollout record per epoch for the intent term (existing ~2 forwards: value + score) => roughly +40-50% PPO optimizer compute, plus 2 no-grad passes over the rollout (intent loss before/after). Imitation phase: +1 forward per bank pair per pass (+~100% of that phase) plus 2 no-grad bank passes. Runtime: one extra trunk forward per control step for publishing. All small next to the 1800 s pace / SUMO episode time.
open_issues: Base run_separate lacks report keys last_loss/last_gradient_norm (KeyError in exact_update); fixed on c4/imit-fix2 (128516c9). Tests shim only absent keys. The c4/imit-fix2 rewrite of run_separate will conflict with the 2-line hook: re-add 'if getattr(policy,"intent_horizon",0): loss=loss+v2v_intent.bank_term(policy,batch)' after its AWR loss line in attempt_pass.
Bank partner intents are the partners' recorded commands from the winning tape (hindsight broadcast), whereas deployed intents are head predictions; train/deploy gap disclosed.
Targets are issued pre-safety absolute commands (native+residual or plan absolute, clipped to accel_bounds), not post-safety issued_safe (not recorded in steps).
Legacy bank_imitation.run bounds KL vs the pre-PPO policy: with a cold Adam fixture one PPO step exceeds .045 and blocks imitation (pre-existing behaviour, not intent-specific).
